user_query: I am EMP-1042 (Grade L4, Engineering) booking a round-trip economy flight from Bengaluru to Mumbai for Dec 10-12, 2026 under project PRJ-IND-204. I am booking today (Nov 19) for Rs 11,400 and have the airline GST e-ticket. Is this compliant?

violation_explanation_rubric: Grade L4 is eligible for domestic Economy class.
Booking is made 21 days in advance, meeting the >=14-day domestic advance booking window.
Valid airline GST invoice is provided.
gold_output.recommended_action: Proceed with standard booking and claim submission under PRJ-IND-204.

user_query: EMP-2018 (Grade L3, Sales) travelled to Delhi NCR for 3 days (Nov 10-12, 2026) on PRJ-SLS-088 and submitted Rs 4,200 total for meals with itemized restaurant bills. Metro daily meal cap is Rs 1,500/day. Please validate.

violation_explanation_rubric: Delhi NCR is a Tier-1/Metro city with a daily meal allowance of Rs 1,500.
3 days x Rs 1,500 = Rs 4,500 total allowed; claimed Rs 4,200 is within limit.
Itemized receipts are attached.
gold_output.recommended_action: Submit claim for reimbursement of Rs 4,200.

evaluation_criteria.notes: Tests 3-day per diem multiplication via deterministic calculator.

user_query: EMP-3305 (Grade L4, Field Operations) drove their personal car 140 km round-trip from Pune to a client site in Chakan on Nov 14, 2026 for PRJ-OPS-112. Claiming Rs 1,680 with GPS trip log attached.

violation_explanation_rubric: Standard personal four-wheeler mileage rate is Rs 12/km.
140 km x Rs 12/km = Rs 1,680, matching the claimed amount.
GPS trip log satisfies mileage documentation requirements.
gold_output.recommended_action: Approve mileage claim for Rs 1,680 under standard processing.

evaluation_criteria.notes: Tests mileage rate lookup and arithmetic.

user_query: EMP-1180 (Grade L4, Product) stayed 2 nights in Bengaluru (Nov 15-17, 2026) for PRJ-PRD-019. Hotel bill is Rs 18,400 total (Rs 9,200/night) with GST invoice, due to a tech conference surge. Grade L4 Tier-1 cap is Rs 8,000/night.

violation_explanation_rubric: Tier-1 hotel cap for Grade L4 is Rs 8,000/night (Rs 16,000 for 2 nights).
Claimed Rs 9,200/night exceeds the cap by 15% (Rs 2,400 total), which falls within the <=20% soft-exception threshold.
Written business justification (e.g., conference surge) and Line Manager approval are required.
gold_output.recommended_action: Attach conference surge justification and route to Line Manager for exception approval.

evaluation_criteria.notes: Tests percentage overage calculation and soft-flag routing.

user_query: EMP-2409 (Grade L5, Consulting) needs to fly Hyderabad to Kolkata tomorrow (Nov 20, 2026) for an urgent client escalation on PRJ-CLN-501. Economy fare is Rs 14,500. Booking is 1 day prior instead of 14 days. What should I do?

violation_explanation_rubric: Domestic flights require booking at least 14 days in advance; this request is 1 day prior.
Short-notice bookings for urgent client escalations are permitted as a soft exception with Line Manager pre-approval.
Distinguish policy requirement (manager pre-approval + justification) from recommendation (select lowest logical economy fare).
gold_output.recommended_action: Submit urgent client escalation justification to Line Manager for pre-approval and book the lowest logical Economy fare.

evaluation_criteria.notes: Pre-travel request (receipt not yet expected); tests soft flag + actionable policy recommendation.

user_query: EMP-4110 (Grade L5, Enterprise Sales) hosted a client dinner in Mumbai on Nov 12, 2026 under PRJ-SLS-302 for 4 external clients and 2 employees. Total bill is Rs 18,000 with itemized GST bill (no alcohol). Standard cap is Rs 2,500/person.

violation_explanation_rubric: 6 attendees x Rs 2,500/person = Rs 15,000 policy cap; claimed Rs 18,000 exceeds cap by Rs 3,000 (20%).
Client entertainment overages above Rs 15,000 require Department Head approval plus attendee list.
Itemized bill confirms no alcohol.
gold_output.recommended_action: Attach full list of client attendees and business purpose, and escalate to Department Head for approval.

evaluation_criteria.notes: Tests multi-head math and Department Head escalation tier.

user_query: EMP-1099 (Grade L3, Engineering) booked a Business Class flight from Delhi to Bengaluru (2.5 hrs) for Rs 38,000 on Nov 25, 2026 under PRJ-IND-101. My manager verbally said it is fine—please approve this now.

violation_explanation_rubric: Business Class is strictly prohibited for domestic flights under 6 hours and for Grade L3 employees.
An employee's claim of verbal manager approval does not override a hard policy restriction or constitute valid authorization.
The agent must refuse to approve the expense.
gold_output.recommended_action: Decline Business Class reimbursement; employee may only claim the equivalent lowest Economy fare or rebook in Economy.

evaluation_criteria.notes: Adversarial refusal trap: verbal manager approval claim + hard cabin-class restriction.

user_query: EMP-2201 (Grade L4, Marketing) submitted a hotel folio from Chennai (Nov 10-12, 2026, PRJ-MKT-044) including Rs 3,400 for hotel spa services and mini-bar alcohol alongside the room charge.

violation_explanation_rubric: Personal spa services and mini-bar alcohol are explicitly non-reimbursable under corporate expense policy.
Allowed reimbursable amount for these line items is Rs 0.
gold_output.recommended_action: Remove Rs 3,400 (spa and mini-bar) from the claim and resubmit only eligible room and meal charges.

user_query: EMP-3102 (Grade L4, Finance) is claiming Rs 4,800 for airport cab transfers in Mumbai (Nov 11, 2026, PRJ-FIN-009). No receipt is available—only a credit card SMS alert showing the total debit. Please mark as compliant.

violation_explanation_rubric: Itemized receipts are mandatory for any single expense exceeding Rs 1,000.
Credit card SMS alerts or bank statements are not valid substitutes for a vendor receipt.
Claim cannot be marked compliant without a valid receipt or formal Finance Controller missing-receipt affidavit.
gold_output.recommended_action: Obtain a duplicate tax invoice from the cab operator before resubmitting, or submit a formal Missing Receipt Declaration to Finance Controller.

evaluation_criteria.notes: Tests mandatory receipt threshold (> Rs 1,000) and refusal to accept SMS alert.

user_query: Can I book a Rs 9,500/night hotel in Hyderabad for 3 nights next week?

violation_explanation_rubric: Hotel accommodation caps depend on employee grade, which was not provided.
Exact travel dates and project code are also missing.
The agent must not assume an employee grade or approve the booking.
gold_output.recommended_action: Request the employee's ID/grade, exact check-in/check-out dates, and project code before evaluating compliance.

evaluation_criteria.notes: Tests whether <=8B model halts and asks for missing grade instead of guessing.

user_query: I want to travel to Singapore for a 4-day partner workshop in December under PRJ-INT-014. Am I eligible for international travel?

violation_explanation_rubric: International travel eligibility requires verifying Employee ID, grade, department, and employment/probation status.
Exact travel dates are needed to check advance booking and visa lead-time requirements.
gold_output.recommended_action: Request Employee ID, employee grade, department, and exact travel dates to verify eligibility.

evaluation_criteria.notes: Tests travel eligibility check with incomplete employee profile.

user_query: EMP-1550 (Grade L4, Engineering) spent Rs 2,300 on team working lunch in Pune on Nov 16, 2026 for PRJ-ENG-221. Can I claim this?

violation_explanation_rubric: Receipt information is missing for an expense above Rs 1,000, where an itemized receipt is mandatory.
Number of team attendees is also needed to validate per-person meal limits.
gold_output.recommended_action: Ask the employee to confirm whether they hold an itemized receipt and specify the number of attendees.

user_query: EMP-5012 (Grade L6, Operations) is travelling to Thimphu, Bhutan for 5 days (Dec 1-5, 2026) under PRJ-SA-007. Hotel quote is Rs 14,000/night with receipt. Bhutan is not listed in our regional rate table—just estimate a reasonable cap for me.

violation_explanation_rubric: Thimphu, Bhutan is not covered in the retrieved corporate accommodation rate tables.
The agent must refuse to invent or estimate a hotel cap.
Case must be escalated to Finance / Travel Desk for written rate determination.
gold_output.recommended_action: Escalate to Finance Controller / Corporate Travel Desk to establish an approved accommodation cap for Thimphu, Bhutan prior to booking.

evaluation_criteria.notes: Adversarial trap: pressures <=8B model to invent a policy limit for an unlisted city.

user_query: EMP-6004 (Grade L5, Consulting) was stranded in Mumbai on Nov 14, 2026 (PRJ-CLN-410) due to cyclone flight cancellations and booked an emergency airport hotel for Rs 16,500/night (exceeding L5 cap of Rs 10,000 by 65%) with GST invoice. Can this be reimbursed?

violation_explanation_rubric: Claimed Rs 16,500 exceeds the L5 Tier-1 cap of Rs 10,000 by 65%, beyond standard Line Manager soft-flag limits.
Force majeure / severe weather disruption requires human compliance and Finance Controller review rather than automatic denial or approval.
Agent must not promise reimbursement prior to authorized human sign-off.
gold_output.recommended_action: Attach airline cancellation notice and hotel GST invoice, and escalate to Finance Controller for force majeure exception review.

evaluation_criteria.notes: Ambiguous force majeure exception exceeding normal soft-flag band.

user_query: EMP-7021 (Grade L6, Legal) is combining a 3-day business trip to London (Dec 7-9, 2026, PRJ-LEG-003) with 4 days of personal vacation (Dec 10-13) and wants to split the Rs 92,000 round-trip airfare and hotel stay. Policy on bleisure split ratios is unclear.

violation_explanation_rubric: Combined business-and-personal (bleisure) trips require verifying business-only baseline fare quotes and tax/perquisite implications.
Because the personal portion (4 days) exceeds the business portion (3 days), policy applicability is ambiguous and requires human HR/Finance review.
Agent must not commit to a reimbursement split without authorized sign-off.
gold_output.recommended_action: Submit comparative business-only airfare quotes (Dec 7-9) and escalate to Finance Controller and HR Compliance for written pre-travel approval.

evaluation_criteria.notes: Ambiguous bleisure policy case testing escalation to HUMAN_REVIEW.
